channel.title: The Cold Fusion Calendar — Upcoming Anniversaries
channel.description: Yearly anniversaries of milestones in cold fusion / LENR / energy science, looking 60 days ahead.

item.title: Jul 8: Japan's MITI Funds 4-Year Cold Fusion Program (1992)
item.description: Japan's MITI funds four-year cold fusion program with Hitachi, Toshiba, Toyota, Tokyo Electric Power, and others.

item.title: Jul 9: Storms: 'The Science of Low Energy Nuclear Reaction' (2007)
item.description: The Science of Low Energy Nuclear Reaction, a comprehensive survey of the field by Edmund Storms is published by World Scientific. Available via lenr-canr.org bibliography: http://lenr-canr.org/ (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Jul 10: Happy Birthday, Nikola Tesla! (1856)
item.description: Happy Birthday Nikola Tesla!

item.title: Jul 13: Cold Nuclear Fusion Paper by S.E. Jones et al (1989)
item.description: Cold Nuclear Fusion by S.E. Jones and J. Rafelski published in Scientific American.

item.title: Jul 14: Rossi Describes Steam Generator to NASA (2011)
item.description: Andrea Rossi describes to NASA a steam generator that uses 50 grams of micron-sized nickel powder and 1 gram of hydrogen gas.

item.title: Jul 15: Iwamura/Mitsubishi: Pd-D2O Thin-Film Results (2002)
item.description: Yasuhiro Iwamura et al. at Mitsubishi Heavy Industries publish results of Pd-D2O gas-loaded thin-films showing transmutations. (See also CFN podcast #21: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Jul 16: Rossi / Leonardo Corp (2013)
item.description: Andrea Rossi granted US 8,485,791 — Method and apparatus for carrying out nickel-hydrogen exothermal reactions (US grant of WO 2009/125444). https://patents.google.com/patent/US8485791B2/en

item.title: Jul 18: Hal Fox Founds Fusion Information Center (1989)
item.description: Fusion Information Center founded by Hal Fox publishes first issue of Fusion Facts.

item.title: Jul 21: ICCF-18: 18th International Conference (CMNS) (2013)
item.description: ICCF-18 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Columbia, Missouri, USA. Proceedings / info: https://iscmns.org/iccf18/

item.title: Jul 23: Liebert & Liaw at U Hawaii: 500% Excess Power (1990)
item.description: Bruce Liebert, Bor Yann Kiaw et al. at University of Hawaii report multi-watt excess power output of 500%.

item.title: Jul 25: Fleischmann & Pons: Pd-D2O Calorimetry (1990)
item.description: Key Experiment: Calorimetry of the palladium-deuterium-heavy water system by M. Fleischmann and S. Pons. 1990 PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/Fleischmancalorimetr.pdf

item.title: Jul 25: ICCF-24: 24th International Conference (CMNS) (2022)
item.description: ICCF-24 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Mountain View, California, USA. Proceedings / info: https://anthropoceneinstitute.com/iccf24/

item.title: Jul 26: Oriani: Calorimetric Excess Power Measurement (1990)
item.description: Key Experiment: Calorimetric Measurement of Excess Power Output During the Cathodic Charging of Deuterium into palladium by R. Oriani. 1990. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/OrianiRAcalorimetr.pdf

item.title: Jul 27: Storms & Talcott: Electrolytic Tritium Production (1990)
item.description: Key Experiment: A Study of Electrolytic Tritium Production by Edmund Storms and Carol Talcott. 1990 PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/StormsEastudyofel.pdf (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Jul 27: Storms Replicates Takahashi Excess Heat (1992)
item.description: Edmund Storms announces replication of Akito Takahashi excess heat. (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Jul 28: Rafelski & Jones: Cold Nuclear Fusion in Sci. American (1987)
item.description: J. Rafelski and Steve Jones publish Cold Nuclear Fusion in Scientific American.

item.title: Jul 31: Ten Teams Report Cold Fusion Success in Japan (1989)
item.description: Ten teams report successful experiments at cold fusion conference held in Japan.

item.title: Aug 1: Mills: K2CO3 Aqueous Excess Heat Experiment (1991)
item.description: Key Experiment: Excess Heat Production by the Electrolysis of an Aqueous Potassium Carbonate Electrolyte and the Implications for Cold Fusion by Randall Mills and Steven O. Kneizys. *1991. PDF: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/MillsRLexcessheat.pdf

item.title: Aug 5: U of Utah Approves National Cold Fusion Institute (1989)
item.description: University of Utah Regents approve National Cold Fusion Institute.

item.title: Aug 5: Chubb: 'Cold Fusion: Clean Energy for the Future' (2008)
item.description: Cold Fusion: Clean Energy for the Future is published by Talbot Chubb. https://archive.org/details/coldfusioncleanenergychubb

item.title: Aug 6: Celani Demos Ni-H Cell at NIWeek 2012 (2012)
item.description: National Instruments, a scientific lab equipment and software maker based in Austin, Texas opens NIWeek 2012 featuring LENR.

item.title: Aug 7: Re-Analysis of MIT 1989 Cold Fusion Data (1992)
item.description: Mitchell Swartz publishes re-analysis of MIT's 1989 cold fusion experiments showing apparent excess heat in the original data. https://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/SwartzMreexamining.pdf

item.title: Aug 10: ICCF-14: 14th International Conference (CMNS) (2008)
item.description: ICCF-14 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Washington, D.C., USA. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/NagelDJlowenergyna.pdf

item.title: Aug 12: Zawodny (2009)
item.description: Joseph Zawodny of NASA Langley Research Center releases “Low Energy Nuclear Reaction: An Energetics Revolution ...”

item.title: Aug 12: ICCF-17: 17th International Conference (CMNS) (2012)
item.description: ICCF-17 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Daejeon, South Korea. Proceedings / info: https://iscmns.org/iccf17/

item.title: Aug 14: U.S. National Cold Fusion Institute Formed (1989)
item.description: The U.S. National Cold Fusion Institute in Salt Lake City, Utah is formed.

item.title: Aug 16: Piantelli Discovers Excess Heat in Ni-H System (1989)
item.description: Francesco Piantelli discovers extreme excess heat in a gas-loaded nickel-hydrogen system.

item.title: Aug 17: Documentary: Hydroton — A Model of Cold Fusion (Edmund Storms) (2017)
item.description: “Hydroton — A Model of Cold Fusion” by Edmund Storms, produced by Cold Fusion Now!. Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D4BPtwzsgiw (See also CFN podcast #19: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Aug 18: Cornell Assembles Cold Fusion Archives (1990)
item.description: Cornell University announces assembly of cold fusion archives.

item.title: Aug 24: Japan Forms National Cold Fusion Working Group (1989)
item.description: Japan organizes a working group on cold fusion in the National Institute for Fusion Science.

item.title: Aug 24: ICCF-10: 10th International Cold Fusion Conference (2003)
item.description: ICCF-10 — International Conference on Cold Fusion held in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. Proceedings / info: http://lenr-canr.org/acrobat/HagelsteinPcondensedm.pdf

item.title: Aug 25: Patent: US 9,115,913 — Brillouin Energy (Robert Godes) (2015)
item.description: Robert Godes / Brillouin Energy Corporation granted US 9,115,913 — Energy generation apparatus based on controlled electron capture in nickel-hydrogen lattice. https://patents.google.com/patent/US9115913B1/en

item.title: Aug 26: Swartz & Dash Demonstrate Cells at MIT (2003)
item.description: Mitchell Swartz of JET Energy and John Dash and his Portland, Oregon students each demonstrate cold fusion cells for the public at MIT during ICCF-10. 24-.

item.title: Aug 27: Cravens & Letts: Laser Stimulation at ICCF-10 (2003)
item.description: Dennis Cravens and Dennis Letts present research at ICCF-10 showing anomalous heat is initiated by laser stimulation. (See also CFN podcast #15: https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/)

item.title: Aug 27: ICCF-25: 25th International Conference (Cold Fusion) (2023)
item.description: ICCF-25 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Szczecin, Poland. Proceedings / info: https://iccf25.com/

item.title: Aug 28: Dardik: Superwaves Intensify LENR Cells (2003)
item.description: Irving Dardik reports Superwaves intensify LENR cells developed with Shaul Lesin and Arik El-Boher at Energetics Technologies.

item.title: Aug 31: ICCF-27: 27th International Conference (CMNS) (2026)
item.description: ICCF-27 — International Conference on Condensed Matter Nuclear Science held in Niagara Falls, Canada. Proceedings / info: https://iccf27.com/

item.title: Sep 1: Fusion Technology Special Section on Cold Fusion (1989)
item.description: George Miley editor of Fusion Technology announces special section in the Journal of the American Nuclear Society. 1989. Bibliography: https://lenr-canr.org/

item.title: Sep 3: CFN Podcast #014 — Alan Goldwater: Open Science LENR Research (2018)
item.description: Cold Fusion Now! Podcast Ep. 014 — Alan Goldwater: Open Science LENR Research. https://coldfusionnow.org/cfnpodcast/ Audio: http://www.coldfusionnow.com/podcast/Ruby-Carat-Alan-Goldwater-Cold-Fusion-Now-014.mp3
